response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced and versatile software craftsman, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web, mobile, and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, JavaScript) rather than the C++/STL, industrial automation, and IEC 62443 security expertise this role requires. His only substantial C++ experience was a brief 6-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and there is no evidence of message brokers, MQTT/REST for IoT, multi-threaded systems architecture, or industrial protocol experience. This profile does not align with the core technical or industry requirements of the role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated architecture, TDD, CI/CD, and mentoring skills applicable to any senior role
Strong communication and documentation skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source projects
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (single ~6-month role, 10+ years ago)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No background in industrial automation, MQTT, message brokers, or relevant protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: No IoT/MQTT/message-broker or industrial protocol background
